faqs.answer: A neurologist is the specialist who diagnoses and treats nerve problems. faqs.question: What are the symptoms of nerve damage?
faqs.answer: Common symptoms of nerve damage include numbness, tingling ('pins and needles'), burning pain, sharp or shooting pain, muscle weakness, sensitivity to touch, and loss of coordination. If you experience these symptoms persistently, consult Dr. Yuvraj Lahre for evaluation.

faqs.question: Can nerve damage be treated?
faqs.answer: Many nerve conditions are treatable, especially when diagnosed early. Treatment may include medications for nerve pain, physical therapy, lifestyle modifications, and treating the underlying cause (such as diabetes or vitamin deficiencies). Dr. Yuvraj Lahre creates individualized treatment plans based on the specific type and cause of nerve damage.

faqs.answer: Most spine conditions are managed without surgery through medications, physical therapy, lifestyle modifications, and activity guidance.
